source_title: Gumroad Creatorpedia: All the Answers in One Place
snippet_primary: "The most common items sold on Gumroad are e-books, films, music, software, and tutorials. You can also sell memberships, and one-time purchase products, both digital and physical. We've set up a page of example products for you to see things from a customer's perspective!"
subject_exact: Gumroad most commonly sold product types (e-books, films, music, software, tutorials) as stated by platform
parser_notes: Source dated February 2022. 'Most common' is platform's claim, not independently verified. Films, music, tutorials do not map to schema product_type enum. Source is creatorpedia FAQ page.
